summary: Iteration 24 — RBAC matrix + 6 UI cases verified. Backend: 18/18 pytest passes covering role-permissions matrix (GET/PATCH, admin-locked), login/me permissions, permission-gated 403/200 for caller/manager/admin across reports/marketing/export/users, and full CRUD for /api/leads/{id}/followups with lead sync. Frontend: caller nav hides Marketing/Reports/Admin and direct /admin & /reports redirect to /; admin sees all nav items; Admin>Users shows roles-access-control matrix with admin column locked (17 disabled checkboxes) and roles-save-button present; Automations edit icon opens 'Edit Automation' modal; Custom Fields edit icon opens 'Edit Field' modal and PATCH saves; Leads Columns menu with toggles persists in localStorage across reload; LeadDetail has followup-add-* form and followup-list with edit/delete testids, add/delete flow works, old 'Appointment' label removed; page-level scroll is disabled (body overflow = 0) while inner column scrolls independently.
critical_code_review_comments: core/permissions.py cleanly guards admin from being reduced — good; keep DEFAULT_PERMISSIONS as the single source of truth.
PATCH /admin/role-permissions ignores admin overrides silently — consider surfacing a 200 note (e.g. 'admin_locked: true') so UI can display why admin toggles have no effect.
Frontend leadsColumns localStorage key is a plain array — consider versioning ('leadsColumns.v1') so future column changes can migrate safely.
seed_data_creation: Created one automation rule via POST /api/admin/automations named 'TEST_iter24 rule' (id 30) to be able to verify the automation-edit-{id} icon; safe to delete.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend suite test_iter24_rbac_followups.py can be re-run as regression for RBAC & follow-ups. If automation 'TEST_iter24 rule' remains and clutters Admin > Automations, delete via DELETE /api/admin/automations/30.
